author: Pixar YouTube
text:
A Pixar Short in One Shot
One Shot Productions is an anthology of Pixar Artist Short Films that dares to ask the question, "Do you REALLY need more than a single shot for your story?" The shorts are directed by Brian Larsen and James Robertson and feature the original song "Party Bottoms!" Check out more shorts on Pixar's YouTube Channel and within The Pixar Show!
